## Former Teacher Turned Software Engineer
I got started, as a young teen, programming in BASIC on a used Commodore64 in the early 90s. I quickly found my way to HTML4 and built some of my first websites on GeoCities.

![](C64combo.jpeg)

In college I tried my hand at Computer Science, but was more and more attracted to the Social Sciences and eventually ended up teaching high school Social Studies.

I soon needed better tools to support my students and started building out some simple web apps in PHP on the backend of a Wordpress blog to help me teach in the days before blended learning and EdTech were ubiquitous in the education sector.

After a few years of building my skills, I eventually found myself working for Aspire Public Schools on the Godzilla team alongside the folks who went on to start [Schoolzilla](https://www.renaissance.com/products/schoolzilla/). I've been hacking away ever since building data integrations and web applications to support students, teachers, support staff, and most recently, funders and researchers.

I'm a polyglot programmer with a deep understanding of data integrations, data warehousing, and back-end APIs. I'm a decent full stack developer when it comes to enterprise web apps and work primarily in python these days.

### Interests

I love making music and publish some of my work on Spotify under the pseudonym [Mister Yeti](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0Ppm2v91iFqVZPXMApdlkO) and on Bandcamp as [Drone Coyote](https://dronecoyote.bandcamp.com/).

I'm also a husband and father and love nothing better than spending quality time with my wife and son.
